description: retry/rules.json: what each of the four retry rules retries, as sets. retry/cases.json's rows are examples of them.

boot.description: A boot pass or a bus request, asked about a response's status.

statuses.description: The statuses the rule retries, in ascending order.

job.description: A job's retry budget, asked about a response's status.

statusFrom.description: Every status at or above this one is retried too. It is above every status of `statuses`.

transport.description: An HTTP client's request, asked about a response's status, the request's method, and whether it carries an `Idempotency-Key`. It is retried at one of `statuses` when it carries a key or its method is one of `idempotentMethods`, and at no other status.

idempotentMethods.description: The methods a repeat of which cannot cause a second effect (RFC 9110 § 9.2.2), in capitals. A request's method is read in any case.

refresh.description: Exchanging a refresh token at its issuer, asked about the issuer's answer.

noResponse.description: Whether the exchange is retried when the issuer gave no answer at all.
